_comment: This file is a Sphinx documentation configuration file (conf.py) for pybind11. It contains module-level configuration variables and Sphinx event handler callbacks. It has no CLI interface or standalone callable APIs. Per instructions, files without callable code suitable for a simple argparse CLI module are excluded from example entries.
review_conf_py: review the Sphinx conf.py configuration file for pybind11 documentation build settings
summarize_extensions: summarize the Sphinx extensions configured in conf.py including breathe and rsvgconverter
review_generate_doxygen_xml: review the generate_doxygen_xml function that runs doxygen to produce XML for breathe
review_prepare: review the prepare function that copies and transforms README.rst for LaTeX builds
review_setup: review the setup function that registers Sphinx builder-inited and build-finished event hooks
